title: RuneScape 3 plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: Manifest for an RS3 Plugin Hub Lua plugin. See https://developer.runescape.com/rs/structure.html

oneOf.description: Plugin names. Each dependency is imported under its plugin name.

prettyui.description: PrettyUI (J3): native-looking windows, panels, buttons, fields and graphs, used as the global prettyui. The editor loads its definitions when this is listed. Docs: https://prettyui.j3.gg/

oneOf.description: Plugin hub (mod.io) ID of the dependency.
Map of variable name -> plugin hub ID (or plugin name). The dependency is available as a global with that variable name, e.g. "prettyui": 6398181.

defaultSnippets.label: PrettyUI
defaultSnippets.description: Add PrettyUI as a dependency (global prettyui)

enumDescriptions: Enables HTTP requests to the base URLs listed in "urls".
Enables the Chat API and the ChatMessage event.

contactEmailAddress.description: Contact address shown to users (a legal requirement). Jagex recommends it differs from your mod.io account email.

requiredDependencies.description: Plugins this plugin needs in order to work.

optionalDependencies.description: Plugins that add functionality but are not needed. Changes are reported via Event.OptionalDependencyChanged.

requiredPermissions.description: Permissions the plugin needs to function.

optionalPermissions.description: Permissions that only add functionality. Check at runtime with Plugin.HasPermission(PluginPermissions.X).

urls.description: Base URLs the plugin may call, read in Lua as Plugin.urls.<name>. HTTP/HTTPS only; no URL shorteners or redirect services (plugins are rejected for these).

hasSettingsIcon.description: Show a settings icon; required for Event.SettingsLayerReady.

hasRibbonIcon.description: Show a ribbon icon; required for Event.ContentLayerReady.

^remote.description: Fields added for plugins retrieved from a remote repository.
